answer: Locks are written down in signal, expire in saffron, and garden lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 9 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Someone running 48 aliases therefore needs 91 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 1617 identities would post 3539 proofs and burn roughly 41 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
